description: Shared column definitions used across Table 7A-7J. Each table row's 'installations' object uses these keys with value 'R' (Required) or 'NR' (Not Required).

protection_level_codes.HL: Hose-stream-only protection level (see table7k_7m_water_calc.json, Table 7M). Ranges HL-1 (lightest) to HL-6 (heaviest) across the source tables.
protection_level_codes.CL: Combined protection level - sprinkler + hose stream (see table7k_7m_water_calc.json, Table 7K). Ranges CL-1 (lightest) to CL-8 (heaviest, High Hazard) across the source tables.

self_certification_note: Every occupancy in Table 7A-7J carries a self-certification threshold (varies by occupancy - e.g. up to 500 sqm AND up to 24 m height for Residential, up to 500 sqm AND up to 9 m for Assembly/Storage/Hazardous, etc.). Below that threshold, self-certification by a certified and State-approved building professional is treated as acceptable in place of the full Table 7 installation requirements. This threshold is captured per-occupancy in each table7_*.json file as 'self_certification_threshold'.
remarks_applicable_to_all_tables: REMARK 1: Where the municipal supply provides a public yard hydrant system meeting wet riser demand flow/pressure 24x7, a state/area/jurisdiction may substitute a dry riser system (with its own pumping/storage) for the wet riser system, for buildings up to 24 m where HL protection is required. Dry riser is also recommended where ambient temperature is below 4 C. Requires quarterly integrity checks.
REMARK 2: Water storage tank sharing may be permitted between adjacent neighbouring properties (including industry clusters) without loss of hydraulic effect.
